---
title: ""
subtitle: ""
date: today
lang: es
format:
  typst:
    papersize: a4
    margin:
      x: 1.8cm
      y: 2.2cm
    fontsize: 10pt
    include-in-header:
      text: |
        #set text(font: "Arial", size: 10pt)
        #set par(justify: false)

        #show heading.where(level: 1): it => {
          v(0.8em)
          block(width: 100%, fill: rgb("#1a4a7a"), inset: (x: 10pt, y: 7pt), radius: 3pt)[
            #text(fill: white, weight: "bold", size: 12pt)[#it.body]
          ]
          v(0.4em)
        }
        #show heading.where(level: 2): it => {
          v(0.6em)
          block(width: 100%, fill: rgb("#2e5b9e"), inset: (x: 8pt, y: 5pt), radius: 2pt)[
            #text(fill: white, weight: "bold", size: 10.5pt)[#it.body]
          ]
          v(0.3em)
        }
        #show heading.where(level: 3): it => {
          v(0.4em)
          block(width: 100%, fill: rgb("#1a4a7a"), inset: (x: 7pt, y: 4pt), radius: 2pt)[
            #text(fill: white, weight: "bold", size: 9.8pt)[#it.body]
          ]
          v(0.2em)
        }
execute:
  echo: false
  warning: false
  message: false
params:
  path_rds: null
---

```{r, results='asis'}
if (is.null(params$path_rds) || !file.exists(params$path_rds)) {
  stop("No se encontro `params$path_rds` para renderizar el reporte.", call. = FALSE)
}

bundle <- readRDS(params$path_rds)
doc <- as.character(bundle$typst_doc)[1]
if (is.na(doc) || !nzchar(trimws(doc))) {
  stop("`bundle$typst_doc` esta vacio.", call. = FALSE)
}

cat("```{=typst}\n")
cat(doc)
cat("\n```\n")
```
